stops.name: Gantrisch-Panoramaweg
stops.quote: The Gantrisch Panoraweg Path offers a scenic pre-Alps hike with many spectacular viewpoints.
stops.english: The Gantrisch Panoraweg Path offers a scenic pre-Alps hike with many spectacular viewpoints.

stops.name: Gantrisch Königsroute
stops.quote: The Königsroute – the route of kings –combines the best parts into a fantastic circular tour.
stops.english: The Königsroute – the route of kings –combines the best parts into a fantastic circular tour.

stops.name: Alpbeizli Gantrischli
stops.quote: We are happy to spoil you with regional delicacies in our Alpbeizli.
stops.english: We are happy to spoil you with regional delicacies in our Alpbeizli.

stops.name: Gantrisch Bike-Panoramaweg
stops.quote: The «Gantrisch Bike-Panoramaweg» is considered a beginners tour in the Gantrisch Biking portfolio and allows plenty of time to enjoy the beautiful scenery.
stops.english: The «Gantrisch Bike-Panoramaweg» is considered a beginners tour in the Gantrisch Biking portfolio and allows plenty of time to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

stops.name: Gurnigel
stops.quote: The Gantrisch landscape reserve provides the delightful context for this loop featuring the Gurnigel, a pass popular with local cyclists.
stops.english: The Gantrisch landscape reserve provides the delightful context for this loop featuring the Gurnigel, a pass popular with local cyclists.

stops.name: Schloss Schwarzenburg
stops.quote: Mit dem Adventsfenster laden wir zu einem gemütlichen Abend im Schloss Schwarzenburg ein.
stops.english: With the Advent window, we invite you to a cozy evening at Schwarzenburg Castle.

stops.name: Schwarzsee
stops.quote: Diemtigtal, Gantrisch & Gruyère Pays-d‘Enhaut Wild roses and untouched forests in the Diemtigtal, rough and rugged peaks in the Gantrisch and the romantic Schwarzsee followed by the lovely Jauntal:…
